en: This postcard features a black and white photograph of a large wooden house or manor with a prominent tower, located at the end of a tree-lined path with rustic fencing. The building is set on a hill and has a large flag flying from the tower. The caption at the top left reads 'Tomtebo. Ånge.' The reverse side displays handwritten text, multiple translations of 'Postcard', an old green Swedish stamp, a Sundsvall museum label, and a postmark reading 'BRÄCKE' with the year '1910'.
